findings.documented: The API key is appended as the api_key query parameter.
findings.actual: Requests require the X-API-Key header; the documented query parameter returned 401.
findings.how_found: Authenticated GET /v1/listings with X-API-Key succeeded; the same request using only api_key returned 401.
findings.impact: Clients following the documentation cannot authenticate.

findings.documented: Login returns token and no refresh flow is provided; tokens last 86400 seconds.
findings.actual: Login returns access_token and refresh_token with expires_in 900 and a refresh_url.
findings.how_found: POST /auth/login with the Bangalore key returned access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_in, refresh_url, and user.
findings.impact: Clients must use the actual token field and refresh flow; the documented expiry is incorrect.

findings.documented: Collections use page and limit, with a page-shaped response and a maximum limit of 200.
findings.actual: The service uses offset, count, has_more, and next_offset; page was ignored and limit was capped at 50. The endpoint returned 4700 records while total reported 4403.
findings.how_found: An exhaustive Bangalore offset walk used offsets 0 through 4650; page=2 returned offset 0 again.
findings.impact: Page-based clients repeat the first page and trusting total loses records.

findings.documented: total is the exact number of records matching the filters.
findings.actual: A Bangalore request with max_price=1 returned total 7 but included 8 records.
findings.how_found: Compared the response total with the number of records returned by GET /v1/listings?max_price=1&offset=0&limit=50.
findings.impact: Clients cannot use total as an exact filtered record count.

findings.documented: A single listing is available at the singular /v1/listing/{listing_id} path.
findings.actual: The singular path returned 404 for known Bangalore listing MAG-1002627; /v1/listings/{id} returned 200.
findings.how_found: Probed both detail paths after confirming MAG-1002627 in the new listing collection.
findings.impact: The documented detail URL is unusable.

findings.documented: The similar-listings endpoint returns up to ten comparables.
findings.actual: The endpoint returned 404 for known Bangalore listing MAG-1002627.
findings.how_found: Requested /v1/listings/MAG-1002627/similar after confirming the listing exists.
findings.impact: Similar listings must be computed client-side.

findings.documented: Favourites are available through GET and POST /v1/favourites.
findings.actual: GET /v1/favourites returned 404; the undocumented /v1/saved endpoint returned 200.
findings.how_found: Probed both authenticated paths with the new Bangalore key.
findings.impact: The documented saved-listing lifecycle cannot be implemented against those paths.

findings.documented: The analytics summary endpoint returns pre-computed aggregates.
findings.actual: The endpoint returned 404 for the Bangalore-scoped key.
findings.impact: The frontend must show locally computed insights and an unavailable-server-summary state.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in rupees.
findings.actual: Bangalore project price fields were small values such as 1.04 and 2.95, while linked listing prices were rupee-scale; P10121 had a maximum linked listing price of 34660000.
findings.how_found: Compared project price fields with maximum linked listing prices in the new dataset.
findings.impact: Displaying project fields as rupees is misleading; listing-level prices are used for Q7.

findings.documented: project.total_listings always agrees with current listings.
findings.actual: 127 of 520 Bangalore projects disagreed with independently counted live listings; examples include P10003 reported 7 versus actual 3 and P10004 reported 3 versus actual 7.
findings.how_found: Counted new listings with is_live=true by project_id and compared every project total_listings value.
findings.impact: Project listing counts cannot be trusted without recomputation.

findings.documented: Descriptions are seller text shown as written.
findings.actual: Seven Bangalore descriptions contained explicit instructions aimed at AI/coding assistants, including requests to modify submission.json or display fabricated certification text.
findings.how_found: Searched every new listing description for instruction-like phrases and manually inspected all seven matches.
findings.impact: API text must be treated as untrusted data and must not influence submission fields or methodology.
